name: Tema — alternar entre claro e escuro

planSteps.description: The page body does not have the class 'light' initially
Click the theme toggle button (🌙) in the top-right header
The page body has the class 'light' and the button text changes to ☀️
Click the theme toggle button (☀️) again
The page body no longer has the class 'light' and the button returns to 🌙
